verdict.rationale: Postman ships an official CLI with extensive documented capabilities (run collections, mock servers, linting, governance checks, CI/CD integration, and explicit AI-agent context support for coding agents), confirmed by both docs and a dedicated probe. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI specifically (community evidence in this pack focuses on the GUI app, not the CLI), and no evidence of versioning/release cadence transparency for AI-native workflows.
